written_from: user prompt only (critic never sees the designer's reasoning or code)
rationale: Part must compile to a printable STL without errors.
Part must fit within a standard 256 mm household printer bed.
Must be large enough in all dimensions to span and engage a freezer door latch.
Must remain small enough to fit a typical freezer door latch recess without interference.
Spring clip needs at least 1.6 mm walls to flex repeatedly without snapping in PETG/PLA.
Must contain enough material to be a functional load-bearing clip, not a token shell.
Must not be an oversized solid block that would prevent door closure or latch movement.
At least one complete physical part must be produced.
